purpose: Assess an entity's readiness to migrate from EC Sales List (recapitulative statements) to ViDA Digital Reporting Requirements. Checks presence of four ESL fields (seller_vat_id, buyer_vat_id, reporting_period, supply_type), pre-2024 domestic regime flag (harmonization deadline: 2030-07-01 for new regimes, 2035-01-01 for legacy), and transaction_value completeness. Returns migration_ready, drr_gap_fields, and harmonize_deadline. Terminal node of the vida-digital-reporting-requirements chain. Zero network, zero PII. EU 2025/516.
